source:
# Port of lib/pubid/bipm/parser.rb — BIPM identifiers: committee forms
# (short/long EN/FR, meetings incl. French <sup>e</sup>), Metrologia,
# the SI Brochure family, MEP/Guide reports. Groups and type names come
# from gem-extracted tables (bipm_*.yaml), longest-first.
#
# Edition-2 conversion. The builder dispatches on the branch-wrapper
# keys (committee_short, committee_prefixed, committee_long_en,
# committee_long_fr, committee_bare, meeting_en, meeting_fr,
# metrologia, si_brochure, si_brochure_variant, si_brochure_section,
# si_brochure_ordinal_edition, si_brochure_bare_edition, mep, guide),
# so every
# wrapper is kept as a v1-shaped capture whose value is the inner-leaf
# hash (or the bare scalar for the journal-level Metrologia record) and
# binds uncast with the (raw) type; the leaves additionally bind flat.
# Pure-raw rule bodies are inlined at capture sites (digits, alnum) so
# every capture subtree carries only its own named leaves.

grammar PubidBipm version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  digit = %x30-39
  dot = "."
  letter = %x41-5A / %x61-7A
  space = " "
  dash = "-"
  slash = "/"
  colon = ":"
  lparen = "("
  rparen = ")"

  number = (1*digit *(dash 1*digit)) as number
  year = (4digit) as year
  lang = ("EN" / "FR" / %x45 / %x46) as language
  year_paren = "(" year [(", " lang)] ")"
  year_paren_nolang = "(" year ")"
  group = alt from_table "bipm_groups" column "name" as group
  type_abbrev = alt from_table "bipm_type_codes" column "name" as type_word
  type_name_en = alt from_table "bipm_type_names_en" column "name" as type_word
  type_name_fr = alt from_table "bipm_type_names_fr" column "name" as type_word
  connective = "de la" / "du"
  ordinal = "st" / "nd" / "rd" / "th"
  meeting_word_fr = "Réunion" / "réunion"

  committee_short = {
    (
      (
        group
        space
        type_abbrev
        [(space number [(space "A" (1*digit) as appendix [dot (1*digit) as annex])])]
        [(space year_paren)]
      ) as committee_short
    )
  }
  # The publisher-prefixed decision form the corpus cites
  # ("BIPM DECN CIPM/101-1 (2012, EN)"): a literal BIPM publisher lead, the
  # outcome type, then the body-qualified resource-specific-id "{body}/{id}".
  # It names the same document as the unprefixed "<body> <TYPE> <id>" form, so
  # the builder dispatches it through the same CommitteeDocument path.
  committee_prefixed = {
    (
      (
        "BIPM"
        space
        type_abbrev
        space
        group
        slash
        number
        [(space year_paren)]
      ) as committee_prefixed
    )
  }
  committee_long_en = {
    (
      (
        group
        space
        type_name_en
        [(space number)]
        [(space year_paren_nolang)]
      ) as committee_long_en
    )
  }
  committee_long_fr = {
    (
      (
        (type_name_fr [(space number)] space connective space group [(space year_paren_nolang)])
        / (type_name_fr space group slash number [(space year_paren_nolang)])
      ) as committee_long_fr
    )
  }
  committee_group_fr = {
    (
      (
        group
        space
        type_name_fr
        [(space number)]
        [(space year_paren_nolang)]
      ) as committee_long_fr
    )
  }
  committee_bare = ((group space number [(space year_paren)]) as committee_bare)

  meeting_en = {
    (
      (
        (group space number ordinal space "Meeting" [(space year_paren)])
        / (group space "Meeting" space number [(space year_paren)])
        / (group space "--" space number ordinal space "Meeting" [(space year_paren)])
        / (group space "--" space "Meeting" space number [(space year_paren)])
      ) as meeting_en
    )
  }
  meeting_fr = {
    (
      (
        (group space number "<sup>e</sup>" space "réunion" [(space year_paren)])
        / (group space number "e" space meeting_word_fr [(space year_paren)])
        / (group space meeting_word_fr space number [(space year_paren)])
      ) as meeting_fr
    )
  }

  metrologia = {
    (
      "Metrologia"
      [
        (
          space (1*digit) as volume
          [
            (
              space (1*(digit / letter)) as issue
              [
                (space (1*(digit / letter)) as article)
              ]
            )
          ]
        )
      ]
    ) as metrologia
  }

  edition = ((1*digit) "e") as edition
  version = ("v" 1*(digit / dot)) as version
  years = ((1*digit) [(slash (1*digit))]) as years
  si_brochure = {
    (
      (
        ("BIPM SI Brochure" / "SI Brochure" / "Brochure sur le SI")
        space
        ["sur le SI" space]
        edition
        [space version]
        [
          space
          (
            "(" years [(", " lang)] ")"
            / "(" lang ")"
          )
        ]
      ) as si_brochure
    )
  }
  # The language-independent form drops the language code and the version is
  # optional ("SI Brochure 9e (2019, E)"); the guide's French publication
  # identifier leads with "Brochure sur le SI" instead of the English brochure
  # name. A language code may also stand alone in the parens, and the whole
  # parenthetical is optional: the bare-number alias below and the year-less
  # ordinal spelling both name an edition with no year, and their canonical
  # render ("BIPM SI Brochure 9e") has to re-parse. All render in the
  # canonical "BIPM SI Brochure …" spelling. The corpus-cited ordinal-edition
  # spelling normalizes the English "9th edition" onto the canonical "9e"
  # edition value.
  si_brochure_ordinal_edition = {
    (
      (
        "SI Brochure"
        space
        ((1*digit) ordinal) as ordinal_edition
        space
        "edition"
        [(space year_paren)]
      ) as si_brochure_ordinal_edition
    )
  }
  # The unmerged si-brochure-id proposal's bare-number edition spellings
  # ("SI Brochure 9", "SI Brochure 9 (E)", "SI Brochure 9 (2024) (F)"): the
  # edition carries no trailing "e", and the year and the language may each
  # sit in their own parentheses. A parse-in alias of the canonical "9e"
  # edition — the builder appends the "e" the proposal drops.
  si_brochure_bare_edition = {
    (
      (
        "SI Brochure"
        space
        (1*digit) as bare_edition
        [(space "(" year ")")]
        [(space "(" lang ")")]
      ) as si_brochure_bare_edition
    )
  }
  brochure_variant = (("Appendix" space (1*digit)) / "Concise" / "FAQ") as variant
  si_brochure_variant = {
    (
      ("BIPM SI Brochure" / "SI Brochure")
      space
      brochure_variant
    ) as si_brochure_variant
  }
  si_brochure_section = {
    (
      ("BIPM SI Brochure" / "SI Brochure")
      [(space "Part" space (1*digit) as part)]
    ) as si_brochure_section
  }

  appendix_part = {
    "Appendix"
    space
    (1*digit) as appendix
    [(space "Annex" space (1*digit) as annex)]
    space
    "Part"
    space
    (((1*digit) [(dot (1*digit))]) as part)
  }
  mep_code = (1*(digit / letter)) as mep_code
  report_code = ("BIPM-" (1*digit) slash (1*digit)) as report_code
  mep_body = (("SI MEP" space mep_code) / ("Rapport" space report_code))
  mep = (("BIPM" space mep_body space appendix_part) / mep_body) as mep
  guide_kind = ("MeP" / "RSI") as guide_kind
  guide_body = group "-GD-" guide_kind dash (1*digit) as number
  guide = (("BIPM" space guide_body space appendix_part) / guide_body) as guide

  group_leading = {
    meeting_en
    / meeting_fr
    / committee_short
    / committee_long_en
    / committee_group_fr
    / committee_bare
  }
  identifier = {
    metrologia
    / si_brochure
    / si_brochure_variant
    / si_brochure_section
    / si_brochure_ordinal_edition
    / si_brochure_bare_edition
    / mep
    / guide
    / committee_long_fr
    / committee_prefixed
    / group_leading
  }

  entry identifier: identifier

  bindings identifier {
    committee_short -> committee_short (raw)
    committee_prefixed -> committee_prefixed (raw)
    committee_long_en -> committee_long_en (raw)
    committee_long_fr -> committee_long_fr (raw)
    committee_bare -> committee_bare (raw)
    meeting_en -> meeting_en (raw)
    meeting_fr -> meeting_fr (raw)
    metrologia -> metrologia (raw)
    si_brochure -> si_brochure (raw)
    si_brochure_ordinal_edition -> si_brochure_ordinal_edition (raw)
    si_brochure_bare_edition -> si_brochure_bare_edition (raw)
    si_brochure_variant -> si_brochure_variant (raw)
    si_brochure_section -> si_brochure_section (raw)
    mep -> mep (raw)
    guide -> guide (raw)
    group -> group (string)
    type_word -> type_word (string)
    number -> number (string)
    year -> year (string)
    language -> language (string)
    volume -> volume (string)
    issue -> issue (string)
    article -> article (string)
    edition -> edition (string)
    version -> version (string)
    years -> years (string)
    variant -> variant (string)
    part -> part (string)
    appendix -> appendix (string)
    annex -> annex (string)
    mep_code -> mep_code (string)
    report_code -> report_code (string)
    guide_kind -> guide_kind (string)
    ordinal_edition -> ordinal_edition (string)
    bare_edition -> bare_edition (string)
  }

  test {
    accept "SI Brochure 9e v3.0 (2019, EN)"
    accept "SI MEP 10"
    accept "CGPM 26th Meeting (2018)"
    accept "Metrologia 24 3"
    accept "CGPM 12"
    accept "CCTF REC 2"
    accept "BIPM SI Brochure Appendix 2"
    accept "SI Brochure Part 1"
    accept "CGPM -- Meeting 1 (1889)"
    accept "BIPM DECN CIPM/101-1 (2012, EN)"
    accept "BIPM DECN CIPM/101-1 (2012, FR)"
    accept "Décision CIPM/111-10 (2022)"
    accept "Recommandation JCRB/43-1 (2021)"
    accept "CIPM DECN 111-10-2 (2022, F)"
    accept "CIPM DECN 112 A3 (2022, F)"
    accept "CIPM DECN 112 A3.5 (2022, F)"
    accept "SI Brochure 9e v3.01 (2019/2024)"
    accept "SI Brochure 9e (2019, E)"
    accept "Brochure sur le SI 9e v3.01 (2019/2024, F)"
    accept "SI Brochure 9th edition (2019)"
    accept "SI Brochure 9"
    accept "SI Brochure 9 (E)"
    accept "SI Brochure 9 (2024) (F)"
    accept "BIPM SI Brochure 9e"
    accept "BIPM SI Brochure 9e (E)"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
